findings.message:
[P1] Import the election helper before calling it

The new test calls `electCodexResetRecoveryAccount`, but that symbol is absent from the named import from the routing harness at the top of the file. The test module therefore fails to compile, preventing the required regression test and test gate from running.

tests/codex-account-routing-part3.test.ts:1040-1040

summary: The source fix aligns election with the selected cohort, but the added regression test does not compile because its new helper is not imported.

evidence: src/codex/account-routing.ts:167-176 evaluates the selected subscription cohort for reset election, addressing the production mismatch.
